card.name: Partway through Interleukin, Aminosyn, Enlist
card.fires_on: The middle piece of a few specific longer words, such as the 'in' of interleukin, the 'os' of Aminosyn, and the 'list' of enlist or enlistment. It fires before the word is finished.

modes.label: Interleukin
modes.description: The 'in' ending interleuk before a hyphen and a number, as in IL-1 or IL-6.

modes.label: Aminosyn brand
modes.description: The 'os' piece in the amino acid infusion brand Aminosyn.

modes.label: Enlist words
modes.description: The 'list' piece after 'En' in enlistment or enlistees in a military history passage.
